text_blocks.text: Sometimes when you get clubs with a lot of tech, it makes it more challenging to do some of these moves that Dave's giving you. quotes.speaker: Dave Phillips
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Phillips on the importance of ground force in golf
quotes.excerpt: You're pushing the ground away from you to create space on the basketball court.
quotes.quote: If you're doing a fadeaway and the ground wasn't there, it'd be pretty hard to jump backwards. You're pushing the ground away from you to create space on the basketball court. The reason you can pivot and move the way you can and see people the way you are is you don't even know what you're doing, but you're doing it so early. When you play around with basketball with guys that are younger or they don't have what you have, they're late. It's not like they can't do what you do, they just they're so late with when they're doing it, that by the time you've already got them. It's the same thing in golf.
